description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Yasuo''' raises a wall of wind in the target direction for 4 seconds that destroys all hostile non-[[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]] [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectiles]] that collide with it and grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings.
description.text: Active: Yasuo raises a wall of wind in the target direction for 4 seconds that destroys all hostile non- turret projectiles that collide with it and grants sight of its surroundings.

description2.raw: The wall travels in the targeted direction over the first 0.6 seconds, then drifts forward another 50 units over the remaining duration.
description2.text: The wall travels in the targeted direction over the first 0.6 seconds, then drifts forward another 50 units over the remaining duration.

notes.raw: * ''Wind Wall'' grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] in a small static area in front of the cast location. * ''Wind Wall'' starts blocking projectiles on-cast (despite not being fully formed). * ''Wind Wall'' travels via a missile, and thus stops upon colliding with an enemy ''Wind Wall''. * '''Yasuo''' can move during ''Wind Wall's'' cast time.
notes.text:
Wind Wall grants sight in a small static area in front of the cast location.
Wind Wall starts blocking projectiles on-cast (despite not being fully formed).
Wind Wall travels via a missile, and thus stops upon colliding with an enemy Wind Wall.
Yasuo can move during Wind Wall's cast time.
